principles.name: Make state honest
principles.body: Most bugs are a type that disagrees with reality — wider than the real states, narrower than them, or holding two shapes for one truth. The fix belongs in the shape of the data, not in a comment warning about it or an adapter smoothing it over.

principles.name: Eliminate, don't paper over
principles.body: Contorted code is information. A step counter, a translation helper, a branch that defers the problem to a later layer — each is telling you the model is wrong. The test of a real fix is whether it lets you delete something.

principles.name: Test the claim, not the explanation
principles.body: A comment explaining why a check was removed is not evidence the check was unnecessary. Neither is a commit message, a ticket, or anyone's recollection — mine included. When a change rests on "this can't happen," I go try to make it happen. On safety-critical software that habit is the job; everywhere else it is still cheaper than the incident.

principles.name: Go look at the machine
principles.body: The repository describes intent. The running system holds the truth, and the two drift without anything being committed to mark it. Before I say what a deployed system is doing, I go check the deployed system. Configuration drift between environments isn't an edge case — it's the default outcome of not looking.

writing.note: Disabled. Built, working, and deliberately switched off — planned, not abandoned. Turning it on takes two steps: set enabled true here, and rename src/pages/_writing/ to src/pages/writing/. The underscore keeps Astro from generating routes at all, so /writing/ genuinely 404s rather than existing as an empty unlinked page. The first post is written and waiting at src/content/writing/dead-keyboard-fna-winforms.md.

support._note: Every URL here is a placeholder until the corresponding account exists. Nothing renders while enabled is false — a dead donate button reads as abandoned, which is worse than not asking.
support._ctaNote: CTAs are named presets, not one fixed block. <SupportCTA cta="..." /> drops the same links anywhere with copy matched to where it sits — a post footer asks differently than a landing section. Add a preset here rather than hardcoding wording in a component.

default.heading: Support
default.blurb: If something here saved you time — a patch, a write-up, a fix for a bug nobody else had documented — you can put a few dollars toward the next one.

post.heading: Found this useful?
post.blurb: This one took weeks of elimination to write down. If it saved you that, you can chip in toward the next investigation.

tool.heading: Did this fix your game?
tool.blurb: The patch is free and always will be. If it got your keyboard working, a few dollars covers the next weekend of debugging someone else's.
